chinese: 一个丑男人敲了我的门。
pinyin: yī gè chǒu nán rén qiāo le wǒ de mén.
english: An ugly man knocked on my door.

chinese: 他给我讲述了他的一生。
pinyin: tā gěi wǒ jiǎng shù le tā de yī shēng.
english: He told me the story of his life.

pinyin: wǒ bèi bù hǎo.
english: I have back problems.

pinyin: nǐ zěn me yàng? wǒ hěn hǎo, xiè xie.
english: "How are you?" "I'm fine, thank you."

chinese: 我看见一个穿黑衣服的女人。
pinyin: wǒ kàn jiàn yī gè chuān hēi yī fu de nǚ rén.
english: I saw a woman in black.

chinese: 我从来没感觉那么好过。
pinyin: wǒ cóng lái méi gǎn jué nà me hǎo guo.
english: I've never felt better.

pinyin: nǐ yào shi zài zhè r jiù hǎo le.
english: I wish you were here.

pinyin: wǒ tiān hēi hòu bù xǐ huan chū mén.
english: I don't like to go out after dark.

chinese: 我根本不把你放在眼里！
pinyin: wǒ gēn běn bù bǎ nǐ fàng zài yǎn lǐ!
english: I look down on you!

chinese: 大家都知道她的英语说得很好。
pinyin: dà jiā dōu zhī dào tā de yīng yǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
english: Everybody knew she could speak English well.

chinese: 这是我唯一能想到的事了。
pinyin: zhè shì wǒ wéi yī néng xiǎng dào de shì le.
english: It's the only thing I can think of.

pinyin: nǐ qù kàn yī shēng le ma?
english: Did you see a doctor?

pinyin: bié fān yì wǒ!
english: Don't translate me!

pinyin: wǒ yǒu gè bù hǎo de xiǎng fǎ.
english: I have a bad idea.

chinese: 退休后他的收入少了一半。
pinyin: tuì xiū hòu tā de shōu rù shǎo le yī bàn.
english: His income was diminished by half after retirement.

pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ suǒ yǒu de mì mì.
english: I know all your secrets.

chinese: 我不同意她一个人去那儿。
pinyin: wǒ bù tóng yì tā yī gè rén qù nà r.
english: I object to her going there alone.

pinyin: nín néng xiū hǎo wǒ de chē ma?
english: Will you be able to fix my car?

pinyin: wǒ kàn dào nǐ shì xǐng de.
english: I see you're all awake.

pinyin: wǒ rèn wéi wǒ men zhǔn bèi hǎo le.
english: I think we're ready to do that.

chinese: 来吧。我想让你看点东西。
pinyin: lái ba. wǒ xiǎng ràng nǐ kàn diǎn dōng xi.
english: Come on. I want to show you something.

chinese: 你确定他们可以干这个吗？
pinyin: nǐ què dìng tā men kě yǐ gàn zhè ge ma?
english: Are you sure they can do this?

pinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī de lǎo bǎn shì shéi?
english: Who's the boss of this company?

pinyin: zhè běn shū de nèi róng shì shén me?
english: What is the book about?

chinese: 你像是在想其它的事情。
pinyin: nǐ xiàng shì zài xiǎng qí tā de shì qing.
english: It looks like you're thinking about something else.

chinese: 这下搞得你今天累死了！
pinyin: zhè xià gǎo de nǐ jīn tiān lèi sǐ le!
english: You've tired yourself out today!

chinese: 她喜欢为她的家人做饭。
pinyin: tā xǐ huan wèi tā de jiā rén zuò fàn.
english: She likes cooking for her family.

pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ zhé kòu ma?
english: Can you give me a discount?

pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān yǒu kàn diàn shì ma?
english: Are you watching TV today?

chinese: 你没有把你的车上锁吗？
pinyin: nǐ méi yǒu bǎ nǐ de chē shàng suǒ ma?
english: Didn't you lock up your car?

pinyin: wǒ fù qin zhú jiàn hǎo zhuǎn le.
english: My father is getting better by degrees.

chinese: 小寶寶的名字決定好了嗎？
pinyin: xiǎo bǎo bǎo de míng zi jué dìng hǎo le ma?
english: Have you chosen a name for the baby?

pinyin: tā kàn dào le gèng hǎo de míng tiān.
english: She saw a better tomorrow.

pinyin: nà shì shéi fā míng de?
english: Who invented that?

pinyin: wǒ shèn zhì bù què dìng tā shì shéi.
english: I'm not even sure who he is.

pinyin: wǒ xiǎng nǐ kuài diǎn hǎo.
english: I hope you'll get better soon.

pinyin: hěn bào qiàn wǒ shāng hài le nǐ.
english: I'm sorry I hurt you.

chinese: 這或許是個不好的例子。
pinyin: zhè huò xǔ shì gè bù hǎo de lì zi.
english: Maybe this is a bad example.

chinese: 你应该理解，这是严肃的。
pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi lǐ jiě, zhè shì yán sù de.
english: You should understand, this is serious.

chinese: 你们怎么得出这个结论的？
pinyin: nǐ men zěn me dé chū zhè ge jié lùn de?
english: How do you come to that conclusion?

pinyin: nǐ xiǎng yào huǒ bàn ma?
english: Do you want some company?

pinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ lèi de yī fu?
english: What's your favorite item of clothing?

pinyin: nǐ kàn guo nà bù diàn yǐng ma?
english: Have you seen that movie?

pinyin: nǐ kàn dào tā chū qù le ma?
english: Did you see him go out?

pinyin: nǐ mǎi le wǎng fǎn de piào ma?
english: Did you buy a round-trip ticket?

pinyin: wǒ zhǔn bèi hǎo le.
english: I'm ready.

pinyin: kuài yī diǎn hǎo ma?
english: Can you hurry up a bit?

chinese: 他有能力比我做得更好。
pinyin: tā yǒu néng lì bǐ wǒ zuò de gèng hǎo.
english: He can do it better than I can.

chinese: 我所有的尝试都失败了。
pinyin: wǒ suǒ yǒu de cháng shì dōu shī bài le.
english: All of my attempts have failed.

chinese: 他告诉我什么时候该说是。
pinyin: tā gào su wǒ shén me shí hou gāi shuō shì.
english: He told me when to say yes.

pinyin: wǒ de mèng xiǎng chéng zhēn le.
english: My dream came true.

pinyin: wǒ gāi qù shuì jiào le.
english: I have to go to bed.

chinese: 我是网球俱乐部的会员。
pinyin: wǒ shì wǎng qiú jù lè bù de huì yuán.
english: I belong to a tennis club.

chinese: 昨晚我的自行车被偷了。
pinyin: zuó wǎn wǒ de zì xíng chē bèi tōu le.
english: My bike was stolen last night.

pinyin: wèi shén me nǐ bù lǐ wǒ?
english: Why are you ignoring me?

pinyin: tā zài sēn lín zhōng mí le lù.
english: He lost his way in the woods.

chinese: 你对这一切有什么感想？
pinyin: nǐ duì zhè yī qiè yǒu shén me gǎn xiǎng?
english: How did you feel about all that?

chinese: 他毫不犹豫地把自己的车卖了。
pinyin: tā háo bù yóu yù de bǎ zì jǐ de chē mài le.
english: Without the slightest hesitation, he sold his own car.

pinyin: nǐ zài yī gè ān quán de dì fang.
english: You are at a safe place.

chinese: 奥林匹克的起源是什么？
pinyin: ào lín pǐ kè de qǐ yuán shì shén me?
english: What are the origins of the Olympics?

pinyin: mù qián wǒ dāi zài jiǔ diàn.
english: For now, I will wait at the hotel.

chinese: 这所大学是什么时候建的？
pinyin: zhè suǒ dà xué shì shén me shí hou jiàn de?
english: When was this university founded?

chinese: 你的朋友近来在忙些什么？
pinyin: nǐ de péng you jìn lái zài máng xiē shén me?
english: What has your friend been doing recently?

pinyin: nǐ zuó tiān jiù gāi gào su wǒ le.
english: You should've told me yesterday.

pinyin: nǐ huì dài zài jiā ma?
english: Will you stay at home?

pinyin: zhè jiù shì wǒ suǒ shuō de.
english: That's what I said.

pinyin: yīng gāi shì nǐ de huàn xiǎng ba.
english: It must be your imagination.

chinese: 我想要一艘船带我远离这里。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yào yī sōu chuán dài wǒ yuǎn lí zhè li.
english: I want a boat that'll take me far away from here.

chinese: 老实说，我们是来抓你们的。
pinyin: lǎo shí shuō, wǒ men shì lái zhuā nǐ men de.
english: To be honest, we came to capture you.

pinyin: nín yào shén me yàng de fáng jiān?
english: What kind of room do you want?

pinyin: tā shì zài zhàn zhēng zhōng shòu shāng de.
english: He was wounded in the war.

chinese: 这个饭馆的菜是清真吗？
pinyin: zhè ge fàn guǎn de cài shì qīng zhēn ma?
english: Is the food at the restaurant halal?

chinese: 谁能告诉我什么是悲喜剧吗？
pinyin: shéi néng gào su wǒ shén me shì bēi xǐ jù ma?
english: Who can tell me what a tragicomedy is?

pinyin: nà xiē rén yī jiàn miàn jiù chǎo jià.
english: Whenever they meet, they quarrel.

chinese: 汤姆不知道该做什么吗？
pinyin: tāng mǔ bù zhī dào gāi zuò shén me ma?
english: Did Tom know what to do?

chinese: 你不该让他们等那么久。
pinyin: nǐ bù gāi ràng tā men děng nà me jiǔ.
english: You shouldn't keep them waiting so long.

pinyin: nǐ fā shén jīng le ma?
english: Have you gone nuts?

chinese: 一定是有人偷了你的手錶。
pinyin: yī dìng shì yǒu rén tōu le nǐ de shǒu biǎo.
english: Someone must've stolen your watch.

chinese: 你想在这里呆多久就呆多久。
pinyin: nǐ xiǎng zài zhè lǐ dāi duō jiǔ jiù dāi duō jiǔ.
english: You can stay here as long as you like.

pinyin: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi tōu le.
english: My cellphone has been stolen.

pinyin: tā men yuán liàng le tā de zuì xíng.
english: They forgave him for his crimes.

chinese: 你为你的工作感到自豪吗？
pinyin: nǐ wèi nǐ de gōng zuò gǎn dào zì háo ma?
english: Are you proud of your work?

pinyin: wǒ bù xǐ huan gēn rén dǎ jiāo dào.
english: I don't like to socialize.

chinese: 我妹妹嫁给了一个医生。
pinyin: wǒ mèi mei jià gěi le yī gè yī shēng.
english: My sister married a doctor.

chinese: 這些球拍中哪一支是你的？
pinyin: zhè xiē qiú pāi zhōng nǎ yī zhī shì nǐ de?
english: Which of these rackets is yours?

chinese: 以他的薪水不会很富裕。
pinyin: yǐ tā de xīn shuǐ bù huì hěn fù yù.
english: He won't get fat on his salary.

pinyin: zuò ge yíng jiā hěn hǎo.
english: It is good to be a winner.

pinyin: zhè ge xiāo xi yù shì zhe shén me?
english: What does this news augur?

chinese: 你真的不介意我一个人去吗？
pinyin: nǐ zhēn de bù jiè yì wǒ yī gè rén qù ma?
english: Do you really not care that I'm going alone?

pinyin: néng jiā nǐ wēi xìn ma?
english: Can I have your number?

chinese: 你最喜欢的苏打是什么？
pinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de sū dá shì shén me?
english: What's your favorite soda?

pinyin: tā wǎng qiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
english: He can play tennis very well.

chinese: 他睡着的时候，打呼声很响。
pinyin: tā shuì zháo de shí hou, dǎ hū shēng hěn xiǎng.
english: He snored loudly while he slept.

pinyin: wǒ xiāng xìn tā huì xìn shǒu nuò yán.
english: I believed that he would keep his promise.

chinese: 我肯定你会喜欢我们今晚的菜肴。
pinyin: wǒ kěn dìng nǐ huì xǐ huan wǒ men jīn wǎn de cài yáo.
english: I'm sure you'll love what we have on the menu tonight.

pinyin: nǐ xiǎng gēn wǒ qù yě cān ma?
english: Do you want to go on a picnic with me?

chinese: 我住在一個鳥不拉屎的地方。
pinyin: wǒ zhù zài yī gè niǎo bù lā shǐ de dì fang.
english: I live in the middle of nowhere.

chinese: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。
pinyin: tā shòu yāo zuò jù lè bù de zhǔ xí.
english: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.

pinyin: wǒ de wèi zi zài nǎ r?
english: Where is my seat?

pinyin: shéi qù kàn le jīn tiān de zàng lǐ?
english: Who saw the funeral today?

pinyin: wǒ kě yǐ wěn nǐ ma?
english: May I kiss you?

chinese: 你有没有什么喝的给我解渴吗？
pinyin: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shén me hē de gěi wǒ jiě kě ma?
english: Do you have a drink to help quench my thirst?

pinyin: zhè běn shū yǒu hěn duō chā tú.
english: This book has a lot of illustrations.

pinyin: wǒ shì gè jiǎo tà shí dì de rén.
english: I have my feet firmly planted on the ground.

pinyin: wǒ hé tā dōu bù xiāng xìn.
english: I, as well as he, am not convinced.

chinese: 狗和猫你更喜欢哪一个？
pinyin: gǒu hé māo nǐ gèng xǐ huān něi yī ge?
english: Which do you prefer, dogs or cats?

pinyin: nǐ kàn dào de dōu shì huàn jué.
english: Everything you saw was an illusion.

pinyin: nǐ zài yǎn shì shén me?
english: What are you hiding?

pinyin: wǒ mǔ qīn shì ge qí tè de rén.
english: My mother is eccentric.

pinyin: nǐ hé tā shì péng you ma?
english: Are you friends with her?

pinyin: wǒ zhǐ wàng nǐ de bāng zhù.
english: I'm counting on your help.

pinyin: zhè liàng chē bǎo yǎng qi lai hěn guì.
english: It is expensive running this car.

pinyin: tā hé wǒ shì lǎo shī.
english: He and I are teachers.

pinyin: nǐ zuì hǎo qù yī xià yī wù shì.
english: You'd better go to the infirmary.

chinese: 仅三分之一的成员出席了会议。
pinyin: jǐn sān fēn zhī yī de chéng yuán chū xí le huì yì.
english: Only one third of the members turned up at the meeting.

pinyin: nǐ hé wǒ yǒu yī xiē gòng tóng diǎn.
english: You and I have something in common.

pinyin: wǒ bìng bù xiǎng dǎ rǎo nín.
english: I didn't mean to interrupt you.

chinese: 我们能拯救这颗星球吗？
pinyin: wǒ men néng zhěng jiù zhè kē xīng qiú ma?
english: Can we save the planet?

pinyin: wǒ fā shì, zhè cì zhēn bù yī yàng.
english: I swear, this time it's truly different.

pinyin: wǒ yù dào de rén dōu hěn rén cí.
english: The people whom I meet are kind.

pinyin: jǐng chá zhǎo dào zhǐ wén le ma?
english: Did the police find any fingerprints?

chinese: 你不能未经允许就看别人的私人信件。
pinyin: nǐ bù néng wèi jīng yǔn xǔ jiù kàn bié ren de sī rén xìn jiàn.
english: You shouldn't read other people's private letters without permission.

chinese: 对不起，我并不想对你发火。
pinyin: duì bu qǐ, wǒ bìng bù xiǎng duì nǐ fā huǒ.
english: Sorry, I didn't mean to snap at you.

pinyin: tā duì wǒ men sā huǎng le.
english: He lied to us.

pinyin: nǐ tài kě xiào le!
english: You are ridiculous!

pinyin: nǐ zhī chí hái shi fǎn duì duò tāi?
english: Are you for or against abortion?

pinyin: zì sī bù shì wǒ de běn yì.
english: I didn't mean to be selfish.

pinyin: tā zhěng jiù le wǒ.
english: He came to my rescue.
